prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Kobie
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements ana

assessments.note: About 4 years as a Systems Architect with integration blueprints and client onboarding design.
Project management certification and architecture work, but no BRD, SCD, or Epic brief authoring shown.
Built validation pipelines for invoicing errors, but no delivery cost (COGS) estimate validation shown.
No Agile, Scrum, or waterfall methodology appears in the evidence.
Built an AI demo generator, but no RFP, RFI, or proposal materials shown.
Built an operations CRM for staff, but no cross-workstream dependency coordination shown.
Error reduction via validation is adjacent; no scope drift or corrective action planning shown.
No loyalty marketing program or mechanics experience appears in the evidence.
Inventory and supply experience, but not in retail, financial services, or travel delivery.
Built a CRM module, but no MarTech campaign, CDP, or personalization tools shown.
No evidence addresses travel willingness or past travel for work.

output.verdict_line: The candidate fits the architecture experience requirement well but shows gaps in methodology, cost validation, and marketing domain knowledge.
top_gaps: Authoring BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs
Agile/Scrum, waterfall, or iterative delivery methodology experience
